title: Complex multi-step tasks

body.text: multi-step plan that the AI lays out and follows step by step
— Codex breaks it down itself: analyze the code → plan → fix piece by piece → run tests → summarize. You can review the plan before it starts.

example: "Migrate the auth system from session-based to JWT across the whole project — propose a step-by-step plan before starting"

title: Control multi-step work with checkpoints

body.text: checkpoints to stop and wait for review along the way
— e.g. stop after planning, stop after the first module — to adjust direction before damage spreads.

example: "Do steps 1–2 first, then stop for me to review; if it's OK, continue with the rest"

question: How does Codex handle complex work?

options.text: Breaks it into steps, plans, then does it step by step
Does everything at once in one go

question: What are checkpoints in multi-step work for?

options.text: Stopping to review so you can adjust before damage spreads
